title: WPA Protocolometry / Institute Index v1.0 Execution Blueprint
purpose: Operationalise the WPA measurement and future ranking strategy from global institutional discovery through evidence dossiers, scoring validation, shadow comparison, human governance and an optional later public ordinal release.
governing_principles: Measurement first; ranking, if ever activated, is a controlled derived output.
Public evidence only during the evidence-building phase.
NE means Not Evidenced; it is not zero, not an estimate and not a penalty.
Absolute standard-referenced scoring precedes peer comparison.
Institution size, country prestige, marketing reach and follower counts must not become hidden quality proxies.
Agents may discover, extract, map, test and flag; final consequential judgment remains human-governed.
Every published result must remain traceable to methodology version, dataset snapshot and evidence record.
Correction rights and conflict-of-interest controls are part of the measurement system, not post-publication extras.

strategic_output_model.primary: Institutional scorecard across D1-D4 and I01-I20 when evidence thresholds are met
strategic_output_model.required_companion: Weighted Evidence Coverage percentage and indicator-level evidence status
strategic_output_model.secondary: Peer-type diagnostic comparison when a defensible peer sample exists
strategic_output_model.optional_future: Public ordinal ranking only after all release gates pass and a separate human governance decision activates it
preferred_publication_order: ordinal ranking only if separately authorised

execution_stages.name: Independent double scoring
start_conditions: G01 passed and Pilot 20 IDs frozen
two independent assessor assignments issued against the same frozen snapshots

execution_stages.name: Calibration and fairness
start_conditions: Frozen Pilot 20 contains defensible representation of peer types
G03/G04 real scoring and reconciliation completed
approved real peer-type edge cases available

execution_stages.name: Robustness and sensitivity
start_conditions: G03/G04 real scoring and human reconciliation completed
Reconciled real Pilot 20 score corpus available

execution_stages.name: Shadow Index
execution_stages.release_effect: Names and ordinal positions remain non-public

execution_stages.name: Correction and institution review window
execution_stages.release_effect: No public ordinal rank until correction window closes

execution_stages.name: v1.0 methodology freeze
execution_stages.release_effect: Creates v1.0 eligibility, not automatic ranking publication

execution_stages.name: Public release decision
execution_stages.release_effect: Consequential publication only if explicitly authorised

anti_gaming_and_fairness_rules: Do not award quality for institutional size, budget, national power, fame or social-media audience unless an indicator explicitly measures a mission-relevant documented practice.
Do not infer quality from absence of English-language material where authoritative material exists in another language.
Do not double-count the same underlying factual achievement as multiple independent achievements across indicators.
Do not convert promotional claims into high scores without corroborating primary or authoritative evidence.
Do not reward quantity of partnerships; score verified cooperation quality and evidence relevant to I18.
Do not treat missing public evidence as institutional failure unless verified evidence establishes non-conformance.
Do not compare raw ordinal positions across incompatible peer types without displaying the standard-referenced score first.
Do not allow paid relationships, sponsorship, partnerships or participation fees to affect inclusion, scoring or correction decisions.
next_operational_milestones: Reconcile the seven legacy entity-resolution-first coverage cases against the current REV7 corpus before using them for scoring eligibility.
Complete the remaining thirty-eight first-pass Evidence Dossiers.
Select a balanced Pilot 20 from the resolved dossier universe using the published pilot-selection protocol.
Run two independent scoring passes on Pilot 20.
Run calibration, fairness, sensitivity and redundancy diagnostics.
Run a non-public Shadow Index and inspect unstable ordinal movements.
Test the factual correction process on real dossiers.
Freeze Protocolometry v1.0 only after evidence from those tests justifies the final model.
hard_release_rule: No real-institution public ordinal ranking may be produced merely because scores can be calculated. Ordinal publication requires passed readiness gates, a frozen v1.0 methodology, a closed correction test and an explicit authorised human governance decision.
